events.text: Platzeck co-founded ARGUS, a Potsdam environmental organization, with Carola Stabe.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Platzeck co-founded ARGUS , a Potsdam environmental organization , with and at the initiative of Carola Stabe in April 1988 .

events.text: Platzeck joined the Liberal Democratic Party of Germany.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In April 1989 , he joined the Liberal Democratic Party of Germany

events.text: Platzeck left the Liberal Democratic Party of Germany shortly thereafter.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In April 1989 , he joined the Liberal Democratic Party of Germany but left it shortly thereafter .

events.text: Platzeck represented ARGUS at the founding of the Grüne Liga association of local environmental organizations in East Germany.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He represented ARGUS at the founding of the Grüne Liga association of local environmental organizations in East Germany in November 1989 .

events.text: Platzeck was their speaker at the East German Round Table talks during the political Wende.
events.subject: self
events.quote: During the political Wende of 1989–1990 that led to German Reunification he was their speaker at the East German Round Table talks .

events.text: Platzeck represented the oppositional radical Green Party as Minister without Portfolio.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From February to April 1990 he represented the oppositional radical Green Party as Minister without Portfolio

events.text: Platzeck's role as Minister without Portfolio ended.
events.subject: self
